CustomField.description: PICKLIST-FIX 2026-09-10: Admin-defined picklist options for an Offer attribute whose Parameter_Type__c is Picklist, one option per line. Consumed by the offer wizard to build the dropdown choices; kept separate from Parameter_Help_Text__c so option values do not corrupt end-user help text. To revert this feature, delete this field and the code marked PICKLIST-FIX 2026-09-10.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For Picklist parameters, enter one option per line. These become the dropdown choices shown to marketers in the offer wizard.
CustomField.label: Picklist Values
